what: Clicking the bar makes the list panel drop down from 3% above in one beat and float, and the rows follow down from −10px at 32nd-note (.053s) intervals. Clicking again, clicking outside, or pressing Esc folds it away in half a beat

options.bpm: Tempo speed — all lengths are in beats, so this one value changes the rhythm together, default 142 (one beat .4225s)
